task: Cereal box mini easel – cut and fold cereal box cardboard into a small display stand
query: How do I cut and fold cereal box cardboard into a small display stand?

goal.title: Make a stand from a cracker box
goal.description: Empty a cracker box, cut out a broad panel with scissors and fold its panel and flaps into a small freestanding cardboard support. Adjust it on the counter and release it.
goal.final_state: A folded brown cardboard stand remains upright on the counter. It is not loaded with a phone, picture or other object in the video.

procedure.description: Lift the blue cracker box, remove its inner bag of crackers and leave the bag on the counter. Set the emptied box upright.

Retrieve and rub a tissue between the hands. Carry the box to the sink; hold it while adjusting the faucet and tilt its opening down over the basin. Return it to the counter; the image does not clearly show water entering the box.

Lay and turn the box flat, retrieve pink scissors and cut along one long edge, across the short edge and along the other long edge. Rotate and steady the box with the left hand, separating a broad printed panel with attached edge flaps.

Set the scissors down and lay the panel flat. Tap the smartphone, lift and open the small earbud case, retrieve a white earbud and put the case back. Spend an extended interval tapping phone lists, panels and a keyboard before returning to the cardboard.
Lift the printed panel, turn it brown side up, fold it across its width and press the crease flat against the counter with both palms.
Lift and bend the narrow lower strip, repeatedly pinch and reinforce its crease, and open and turn the panel to examine the fold.
Turn the printed side upward, fold and press its lower lip and opposite flap, then turn the folded structure upright with its plain brown face visible. Set the folded base against the counter.

Steady the base and tilt the upper panel to adjust the stand angle. Settle it, release both hands and step back, leaving the cardboard structure standing on the counter. No object is placed on it and no tape application is shown.

coarse.instruction: Empty and arrange the cracker box
coarse.description: Remove and set aside the inner cracker bag, set down the emptied box, wipe hands, carry the box to the sink and tilt it while adjusting the faucet. Return the box to the counter, lay it flat and retrieve scissors.
coarse.goal_contribution: Prepares the box material and cutting tool for making the stand.

coarse.description: Cut one long edge, turn the box, cut its short edge and cut the opposite long edge to separate a broad panel. Put scissors and panel down; an intervening earbud-case and phone interaction follows before folding resumes.
coarse.goal_contribution: Produces the single cardboard panel with attached flaps needed for the stand; phone use does not itself construct it.
coarse.predictability_reason: The emptied box is ready to cut into a cardboard panel.

coarse.instruction: Fold and stand the cardboard panel
coarse.description: Lift and turn the panel, make and flatten a broad crease, fold and reinforce the narrow strip, turn it and fold the remaining flaps. Place the folded structure upright, adjust its angle and release it on the counter.
coarse.goal_contribution: Forms the supporting base and upright face of the small cardboard stand.
coarse.predictability_reason: The cut panel is ready to fold into the stand.
